blocks.text: Business plan banate waqt team ka mil kar kaam karna bohat zaroori hai, khaas taur par jab aap partners (shareek) ya advisors (mushir) ke saath kaam kar rahe hon. Collaborative tools kai logon ko ek hi waqt mein plan mein hissa dalne dete hain, aur foran (real-time) feedback aur tabdeeliyon ka platform dete hain.

Misal: farz karein aap ek dost ke saath bakery khol rahe hain jo baking mein maahir hai, jabke aap karobar ke kaam sambhalte hain. Business plan par mil kar kaam karne ke liye aap Google Drive ya Dropbox Paper jaise tools istemal kar sakte hain. In platforms par aap dono ek hi document par ek hi waqt mein kaam kar sakte hain. Jab aap ka partner products aur recipes wala hissa likh raha ho, usi waqt aap marketing plan aur financial forecast (maali andaza) bana sakte hain.

In collaborative tools mein aksar commenting aur suggestion modes hote hain, jin mein team members asal text badle baghair feedback de sakte hain ya tabdeeli tajweez kar sakte hain. Is tarah aap dono ideas par baat kar ke mil kar faisle kar sakte hain, chahe aap ek jagah maujood na hon. Is ke ilawa version control (purane versions ka record) ki sahoolat se tabdeeliyan track hoti hain aur zaroorat ho to pehle wale draft par wapas ja sakte hain.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text:
Activity ki hidayaat:
1. Koi business idea chunein jo aap ko achha lage. Yeh saada sa bhi ho sakta hai, jaise school bake sale ya naya hobby club.
2. Jo aham hisse hum ne parhe un ki madad se business plan likhein:
   • Executive Summary
   • Business Description
   • Market Analysis
   • Organization and Management
   • Products or Services
   • Marketing and Sales Strategy
   • Financial Plan
   • Appendix (zaroorat ho to; izafi maloomat ka hissa)
3. Apna business plan class ke saath share karein. Batayein ke aap ke khayal mein karobar kyun kamyab hoga aur aap yeh kaise kar dikhayenge.
4. Classmates ke plans par baat karein aur constructive feedback (behtari wali raye) dein. Is se sab apne ideas behtar karenge aur ek doosre se seekhenge.
In qadamon par chal kar aap ke paas apna karobar shuru karne aur apne ideas ko haqeeqat banane ki mazboot bunyad hogi!

blocks.prompt: Mil kar banaye gaye plan mein version control (purane versions ka record) kyun faidamand hai?
blocks.explanation: Agar koi tabdeeli ghalat ho jaye ya koi hissa ghalti se mit jaye, to dekha ja sakta hai ke kis ne kya badla, aur purana version wapas laya ja sakta hai.

items: Collaborative tools: ek saath editing, comments, suggestions aur version control (Google Drive, Dropbox Paper).
